review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner; self-review, not independent approval
review.decision: Simplify existing tool inspector from screenshot: command and result first, one header row, raw arguments on demand
review.notes: User sees duplicate nested labels/JSON and one-command outline plus ANSI remnants. Reuse bounded existing static command extraction; compact presentation only for tool sections, not a global formatter default. Preserve exact full input/result/raw copy and pagination, lossless numbers, truncation identity, disabled actions and provider-neutral schema. Do not execute code or infer success. Raw view never cleans output. Real access/data policy unchanged. New screenshot drives existing-source refinement, not a new prototype. Synthetic rendered tests only; no live input/device operation. New cases and existing browser CAS004 review precede their first edits in this branch.

cases.description: Compact tool details prioritize parsed command, retain original arguments and copy across App/Trace and all agent providers
cases.setup: Synthetic bash argv with one static shell body and optional Python heredoc; result and raw views; actual ToolCallDetails and CodePanel
cases.action: Render/read the production presentation with isolated fixture; inspect initial section then reveal raw and compare source bytes
cases.expected: Command is initial preview when static extraction is safe; one command has no redundant outline; parameter/raw data and original full-copy remain accessible; unknown/dynamic inputs retain original. Default Markdown code reader behavior unchanged

cases.description: Readable terminal output and local working-directory presentation without modifying evidence
cases.setup: Actual ANSI CSI/OSC plus paired already-sanitized SGR only in terminal-result preview; arbitrary JSON/literal examples; valid local file URI, foreign URI and malformed escapes
cases.action: Render/read the production presentation with isolated fixture; inspect initial section then reveal raw and compare source bytes
cases.expected: Preview strips actual controls and recognized paired terminal SGR; lone literal markers and JSON/raw results stay unchanged. Exact raw/copy source remains original. Only local file URI converts to decoded path; unknown/foreign URI stays literal
